calibration_design.scope: Synthetic longitudinal bulk fixture families at explicitly registered dimensions, scientific parameters, inputs and thread/RAM strata only. Independent gene/timepoint/series growth is measured for defaults and the selected major branches. Registered branch slices do not imply coverage of arbitrary parameter combinations, expression distributions, temporal grids, TF counts, hardware or extrapolated sizes; there is no universal precision guarantee.
calibration_design.validation_policy: Keep independently seeded intermediate and off-grid dimensions, expression distributions and registered resource/profile strata outside all calibration inputs and reuse sources. Freeze cost/model/predictions and acceptance thresholds before collecting held-out timings; report interpolation and extrapolation separately. Coverage is not prediction validation.
